faq.question: What materials is this shelving unit made from?
faq.answer: The unit is made from 97% steel, 2% ABS, and 1% PP. It also features a black powder-coated finish for protection.

faq.question: Are the shelves adjustable?
faq.answer: Yes, the height of each shelf is adjustable depending on your needs. The unit also includes adjustable feet that can perfectly fit uneven ground.

faq.question: What is the maximum weight capacity of this unit?
faq.answer: Each individual shelf has a loading capacity of 150 lbs. The total static max load weight for the entire unit is 750 lbs when using the leveling feet.
